==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I am a green skinned, bald, elf man with a flowing white cape and pointed ears. I am flying through a sprawling city. I feel somewhat on edge.

I encounter a strange creature flying in the sky. The creature is partially made of stone and vines, and resembles a humanoid insect. I can tell that it was created by someone nefarious and that it is up to no good.

I stretch my arm out to punch it from a distance. I fire bolts of lightning at it from my fingertips. I successfully defeat the monster, but in the end I am left with more questions than answers.
